_comment: kkpark-map 視覺驗證探針集（POI 落地後在這裡追加條目即可）。expr 回傳物件時請用 JSON.stringify 包起來。

checks.name: markers
checks.expr: JSON.stringify({mis: document.querySelectorAll('.mk-mis').length, hq: document.querySelectorAll('.mk-hq').length, cops: document.querySelectorAll('.cop-icon').length, builds: document.querySelectorAll('.mk-build').length, cells: document.querySelectorAll('.mk-cell').length, heroWrap: document.querySelectorAll('.mk-hero-wrap').length, heroDoll: document.querySelectorAll('.mk-hero-wrap .mk-doll').length, jobDolls: document.querySelectorAll('.mk-job-wrap .mk-doll').length})

checks.name: dolls
checks.expr: JSON.stringify(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mk-doll')).map(function(i){return {complete: i.complete, w: i.naturalWidth, h: i.naturalHeight, animated: /animated/.test(i.src), src: i.src.slice(0, 80)};}))

checks.name: viewport
checks.expr: JSON.stringify({w: window.innerWidth, h: window.innerHeight, dpr: window.devicePixelRatio})
